svg.text: P0 FIXTURE SHEET D — FRAME SCHEDULE (SYNTHETIC, NOT A CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENT)

g.text: CUT LIST (SYNTHETIC)
sole plate 2438.4 (96 in) — used full length, not pre-cut
top plate 2438.4 (96 in) — used full length
full-height studs 2362.2 (93 in) x 6 — one board each
jack studs 2032 (80 in) x 2 — one board each
header plies 1104.9 (43.5 in) x 2 — one board yields both
header spacer 1104.9 (43.5 in) — 1/2 in ply strip
cripples 190.5 (7.5 in) x 2 — from jack offcuts
racking brace 1336.2 · plumb prop 2425.9 (temporary)
Yields include a 3 mm kerf per cut; never more than 2438.4 mm per board.
JOINT AND HEADER SCHEDULE (SYNTHETIC)
doubled 2x6 header: 2 plies 1104.9 + 1/2 in spacer
(38.1 + 12.7 + 38.1 = 88.9 mm wall thickness)
2 screws at every joint, 80 mm apart:
14 plate joints + 2 header joints + 4 cripple ends
= 20 joints, 40 screws total
both header plies bear fully on both jack studs;
cripples bear on the header and the top plate.
Synthetic 8 x 63 mm screw (demonstration only).
PERMANENT-SEGMENT ANCHORS (SYNTHETIC)
3 anchors: 152.4, 762 and 2320 mm (609.6 o.c. where
permanent plate allows; 10 x 60 mm pilot, synthetic)
dashed section = door opening cut out later: no anchor there
FRAME INSPECTION AND BRACING (SYNTHETIC)
Plumb within 3 mm; diagonals differ 3 mm or less
Framed length and height 2438.4 mm
Door opening 952.5 x 2070.1 mm clear
Both header plies bear on both jack studs
In-plane diagonal resists racking (shear);
out-of-plane prop holds the frame plumb.
Remove both temporary members after inspection;
store them for reuse.
Backing work starts only after this inspection is accepted.
